mechanism: Liraglutide increases renal perfusion and glomerular filtration rate, potentially increasing gentamicin clearance and reducing antibiotic efficacy; gentamicin's nephrotoxicity may be potentiated in patients with diabetes or reduced renal function managed by liraglutide.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) before and during gentamicin therapy; ensure adequate gentamicin dosing and therapeutic drug monitoring; avoid gentamicin in patients with significant renal impairment.
